advocate.description:
ADVOCATE—PITHY DESCRIPTION

At a Glance

The Advocate is a phenomenal social combat-oriented character, operating as the party support, or a take-down artist in equal measure.

All-in or Hybrid?

½ Buffing Mentor-oriented character ¼ Cunning Social Manipulator ¼ Vicious Social Duelist.

What Should it be the Best At?

Social Support

Social Dueling, Especially Defense as Offensive

What should it be just “good” at?

Being Charming

Negotiation

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Politico(Any social character that cares about more than one social skill will start to look pretty similar. The Politico is kind of a self-contained mover and shaker, whereas the Advocate is more of “side-kick” in social settings, though grossly powerful otherwise)

Makashi Duelist(The focus on turning flubbed attacks into powerful turnabout is a pretty similar thing to Makashi dueling. A great social defense makes for a solid social offense).
Prophet (The prophet is closer to the Politico, making it a solid primary social character, but with a forcey lean. It does end up being a serious force multiplier with some of its talents, and it does have Twisted Words.)

Advisor(Unfortunately, the Advisor is pretty bleh pile of stuff, but the skills and vibes are pretty similar)

Media Touchstones

Mas Amedda (Episode 1: The Phantom Menace)
Nute Gunray (Episode 1: The Phantom Menace)
Donnel Udina (Mass Effect)
Miles Edgeworth (Ace Attorney)

agitator.description:
AGITATOR—THOUGH IT TAKE A THOUSAND YEARS, WE WILL BE FREE

At a Glance

The Agitator is the Rebel that rolls into a site of Imperial oppression, fans the flame and foments the rising dissent. After the pump is primed, they hand out blasters like match sticks to these would-be rebels, and give a rousing speech to light the spark.

All-in or Hybrid?

⅙ Deception

1/2 Coercion

2/6 Outfitting & Underworld Connections

What Should it be the Best At?

Making Chaos Happen

Encouraging Rebellion

What should it be just “good” at?

Lying
 
Being Generally Cutting

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Enforcer(There's a serious overlap in how they use Coercion and underhanded tactics to solve problems. But while the Enforcer uses it as a hammer and “Enforce", the Agitator uses it like a scalpel. A little push here, a call to action there.)

Marshal(Also uses Coercion to solve problems, but is more about control than chaos).
Media Touchstones

Wilmon (Andor)

Saw Gerrerra (Rogue One)

Nezine (Andor)

Enjolras (Les Miserables)

G’Kar (Babylon 5)

updated 12/10/2025

ambassador.description:
AMBASSADOR—PITHY DESCRIPTION

At a Glance

The ambassador is the “all positive, classic diplomat" character. They are charming, shrewd, and knowledgeable. Also skillful orators, the ambassador uses the motivations of would-be allies to win them to their cause

All-in or Hybrid?

⅓ General Charm (and Leadership) ⅓ Negotiation ⅙ Social Defense ⅙ Charm as a Tool


What Should it be the Best At?

Making and using friends for the greater good of their government

Being Charming

What should it be just “good” at?

Leadership

Being hard to Rattle
 
Negotiation

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Republic Representative(The Rep-Rep is more a pure negotiator, much more like the Arbiter in that sense. Ambassador has to be an equal opportunity schmoozer)

Senator(Senator is structured much more like Politico, playing into Deception and Negotiation than a pure charming character. It dipping its toe into leadership and mass combat is more of a nod to the Senator’s role.).
Arbiter(Pure Negotiation. With some odd enforcer abilities. The big difference is that of a mediator vs an interested party).
Charmer(Probably the closest in overall social structure, using all the tools of Presence to win friends and allies).
Media Touchstones

Leia Organa (Star Wars: Rebels)

Bail Organa (Star Wars: Rebels)

Padme Amidala (Star Wars: Clone Wars)

Londo Mollari (Babylon 5)

Delenn (Babylon 5)

updated 12/10/2025

analyst.description:
ANALYST—CONSTANT BLUR OF SPINNING PLATES AND KNIVES

At a Glance

The analyst is the military or diplomatic attache, capable of fulfilling a comms or technical officer, or being the “know-it-all” character for a more seasoned political type. They are the person who is always in the know, always capable of adding value to any situation through knowledge and insight.

All-in or Hybrid?

3/5 Knowledge as a Tool 1/10 Perception as “in the action” element 3/10  Computers as Communication Offense & Defense

What Should it be the Best At?

Planning and Utilizing Knowledge as utility

Technical Communications

What should it be just “good” at?

Perception and noticing things

Assisting social encounters

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Scholar(Both have a core in being “intelligence support," but while the Scholar only barely supplements their core niche, the Analyst has a sub-niche in Computers. Also, it has a decided use-case rather than generalized "knows things.”)

Strategist(Closest to the Analyst, they function in similar roles both in a party and in a military unit. The strategist obviously has the option to lead a battle if it comes up, but otherwise, they just know things).

Slicer(Barely any overlap, as the slicer is very focused on offensive and defensive slicing, and the underworld in general. Analyst is just all in on knowledge and it's particularly good at codebreaking and shielding intelligence).
Media Touchstones

Kleia (Andor)

EDI (Mass Effect 2&3)

updated 12/10/2025

assault_specialist.name: Assault Specialist
assault_specialist.description: Please see User Data for details.

beast_rider.description:
BEAST RIDER—RIDING THE WINDS

At a Glance

The beast rider is the spec that focuses not just on handling beasts but specifically riding beasts. They know how to look after and leverage their beasts’ abilities.

All-in or Hybrid?

½ Riding Beasts ¼ Beast Care and other beast-related utility ¼ Using beasts in combat.

What Should it be the Best At?

Riding the beasts, both flying, ground based, and aquatic

Punching above their weight, nature beats machine-style.

What should it be just “good” at?

Beast care.

Taming Beasts.

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Hermit(More of the full gamut of “Animal Handling.” Very mystical vs the Beast Rider’s militarism)

Pathfinder(Fighting alongside their bonded creature, but not necessarily riding them. not out of the question though.)

Rigger(Treats their vehicle like a character, where this tree treats the party mascot like a vehicle. Similarities in tone)

Media Touchstones

Steela Gurrera (The Clone Wars)

Cal Kestis (Jedi Survivor)

The Rancor Trainer (The Book of Boba Fett)

Hiccup (How to Train Your Dragon)

commodore.description:
COMMODORE—CAPITOL COMMAND

At a Glance

The Commodore is a bit of a misnomer, as the title would presume a literal command or rank. In reality, Commodore covers the full gamut of command, tactical, and technical positions that would find themself stationed on the bridge or command deck of a capital ship. The Commodore is the captain, the helmsman, or the technical officer, potentially all three.

All-in or Hybrid?

¼ Generic “Capital Ship Leadership” ⅛ Damage Management (Education) ⅛ Systems Management (Computers) ⅛ Navigation (Outer Rim & Astrogation) ¼ Astrogation (Duh)

What Should it be the Best At?

Helming and Command of Capital Ships

What should it be just “good” at?

Leadership

General Computers & Knowledge

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Tactician(The Tactician is a Operational-level army leader, so they are obviously more about managing planetary warfare and infantry/armor)

Ship Captain(Ship Captains are more about their ship, and generally are about trade, social skills, and bolstering the party passively. The Commodore is more of a technical role in addition to being a leader.)

Republic Navy Officer(The Republic Navy Officer is a little more aggressive than the Commodore, who is a more balanced, utility oriented leader)

Media Touchstones

Admiral Ackbar (Episode VI: Return of the Jedi)

Admiral Raddus (Rogue One)

Captain John Sheridan (Babylon 5)

Commander Susan Ivonova (Babylon 5)

Admiral Adama (Battlestar Galactica)

driver.description:
DRIVER—PEDAL TO THE METAL

At a Glance

The driver is, bar-none, the best of the best while driving planetary vehicles of all stripes, especially off-road and in dangerous areas.

All-in or Hybrid?

⅔ Hybrid, mostly engaging with being an excellent planetary pilot, ⅓ with associated vehicle-based Utility like mechanics.

What Should it be the Best At?

Driving, Especially Off-Road

What should it be just “good” at?

Piloting

Mechanics

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Racer
Pilot

Rigger

Media Touchstones

Mad Max/Furiosa

Young Han Solo (circa Solo: A Star Wars Story)

Updated 12/10/2025

droid_specialist.description:
At a Glance

The Droid tech is the “Droid-Weaponizer."  They excel at managing their organization’s Droids, and disabling and appropriating enemy Droids.

All-in or Hybrid?

⅕ Disabling Enemy Droids

⅖ Field Maintenance of Droids
 
⅖ Organizing and Improving Droids

What Should it be the Best At?

Dealing with Enemy Droids, both in combat and with computers

Temporary improvements to Droids

What should it be just “good” at?

General Mechanics

General Computers

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Droid Tech - This is pretty close overlap, the big difference is that ownership and leadership isn't the core focus of the Specialist, rather they kill and repair droids.

Mechanic - The mechanic has a bit of a “tough technical type" vibe, but really their overlap is minor in the general mechanics space.

Shipwright - They may not seem close at first, but the Shipwright and Droid Specialist absolutely focus on improving already-built things like Ships and Droids. Where they differ is in their care to make things from scratch.

Media Touchstones

Babu Frik (Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker)

Updated 12/10/2025

figurehead.description:
FIGUREHEAD—COMMANDER IN CHIEF

At a Glance

The Figurehead is the civilian leader of military command. This character inspires powerful and sincere loyalty and valor of all those who will listen to them. They are unshakable in the face of danger and insurmountable odds.

All-in or Hybrid?

All in on Presence, Hybrid as far as focus
⅘  Being an Inspiring Leader ⅕  Leveraging Figurehead Status for Political/Organizational Favor

What Should it be the Best At?

Pure Leadership

Non-Combat Leadership

What should it be just “good” at?

Sociality

Mass Combat

Being “Confident/Cool”

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Politico(Similar in that they can be genuinely inspiring and bolstering of their allies, different in that they really only lean into the truly positive aspects of leadership)

Strategist(Where a Figurehead is on the holoscreen, the Strategist is at the holo-table crafting battle plans. Both have a significant role)

Media Touchstones

Admiral Ackbar (Episode VI: Return of the Jedi)

Mon Mothma (Episode VI: Return of the Jedi)

Leia Organa (Episode VIII: The Last Jedi)

Delenn (Babylon 5)

ground_support.name: Ground Support
ground_support.description:
GROUND SUPPORT—(Driver Replacement)

At a Glance

The Ground Support is the armor, land, and airspeeder pilot that flies in to force multiply, save the day, and otherwise route enemy armor. They’re not afraid to get deep into enemy territory and push through to the other side.

All-in or Hybrid?

½ General Driving w/ Defensive Focus ¼  Tank as Offensive Power ¼ Perception and Force Multiplier 

What Should it be the Best At?

Driving bulkier, worse handling vehicles, both on the ground and in space

Driving under Poor Conditions

Support of Ground operatives

What should it be just “good” at?

General Piloting

Navigation in space and on land

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Bodyguard(A much more personal-scale combatant that transitions to defensive land vehicles. More about being tanky and supporting infantry while inside the vehicle.)

Clone Pilot(the clone pilot is more about troop transport directly than anything else, but leans into the RAW pilot Direction.)

Gunner(Less about raw output than the Gunner, more about a holistic land pilot during mixed combat.)

Media Touchstones

Bodhi (Rogue One)

gunner.description:
GUNNER—PITHY DESCRIPTION

At a Glance

The Gunner should be the expert at using vehicle based weaponry to tackle the opponents whether it be the main gun of a tank, the turret of a starfighter, or a capital ship turbolaser.

All-in or Hybrid?

⅓ using heavy and Gunnery weapons as a precision “space sniper", ⅓ using gunnery weapons as a bombastic " heavy”, ⅓ being Tanky, but not armored..

What Should it be the Best At?

Gunnery. These guys should be able to bullseye a womp rat without a targeting computer.

Bombing runs. The Gunner should be the best combat bomber.

What should it be just “good” at?

Ranged Heavy and other “heavy weapons” outside of a ship

Being tanky

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Racer(Should be the inverse with Racer being mostly about movement and using the vehicle itself offensively, the Gunner should be all about weapons and barely any actual piloting or driving)

Heavy(The Gunner should be more about specific ship combat and less about personal-scale combat.)

Rigger(Treats their vehicle like a character, where this tree treats the party mascot like a vehicle. Similarities in tone)

Media Touchstones

Any scenes with the Falcon’s gunner positions; Tobias Beckett, Han, Luke, Finn etc

Baze Malbus (Rogue One)

Wrecker (The Bad Batch)

heavy.description:
HEAVY - WALL OF MEAT AND BULLETS

At a Glance

The Heavy lays down the heavy fire, heavy armament, and does it while being a veritable wall of meat.

They are by far, the highest raw damage output of all Hired Guns, but probably every.

All-in or Hybrid?

½ Tank, ½ Spank. Very little utility outside of that.

What Should it be the Best At?

Using heavy weaponry (mostly blasters)

Carrying Heavy Things

Soaking Damage

What should it be just “good” at?

Ship-based Combat

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Gunner(Less about taking out ships larger than their own/whittling them down. More about generic firepower superiority.)

Rigger(Applies personal tankiness, rather than shipboard tankiness)

Vanguard(More about being an unmoving personal mortar than a “stick and move” dodge tank.)

Media Touchstones

CT-782 “Hevy” (The Clone Wars)

Paz Vizsla (The Mandalorian)

Baze Malbus (Rogue One)

Wrecker (The Bad Batch)

Wrex (Mass Effect)

Updated 12/10/2025

hotshot.description:
HOT SHOT - NEED FOR SPEED

At a Glance

The Hotshot is the human embodiment of “brightest stars burn fastest,” - The Hotshot is meant to be flashy, effective, and most importantly, risk-oriented. They will take down the bad guy or die trying, or both. They have the highest highs and the lowest lows of all Pilots, and excel when they’re on a hot streak.

All-in or Hybrid?

½ at mastering piloting a craft, ¼  at using said craft to blast the enemy to little pieces, ¼ Tempting Fate

What Should it be the Best At?

Piloting, they should outclass nearly every other pilot in the game in raw skill.

Taking risks to defeat the enemy.

What should it be just “good” at?

General flying

High-speed antics

Keeping their cool in high-stress situations

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Blockade Runner(Generally as evasive, but only because of significant skill difference and not because of talents that make them harder to hit)

Racer(All about going fast and being effective. Racers are all going fast and avoiding certain death, not about ensuring others’ certain death)

Media Touchstones

Luke Skywalker

Wedge Antilles

Anakin Skywalker (minus force stuff)

Jeff “Joker” Moreau (Mass Effect)

updated 12/11/2025

instructor.description:
INSTRUCTOR—LISTEN UP MAGGOTS

At a Glance

The Instructor is the small L squad leader, focused on the immediate group they are in charge of: Their training, their war-fighting, and their safety.

The instructor has many ways to do so: The hard Ass, the inspiring leader, or the protective mentor. All are valid, because some trainees need some tough love, and a good ass kicking

All-in or Hybrid?

4-Way Hybrid: ¼ Leadership ¼ Coercion ¼ Teaching ¼ Protecting

What Should it be the Best At?

Military Small Squad Leadership

Teaching and Training

What should it be just “good” at?

Armed Conflict

Protecting Allies

Being Imposing

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Marshal(The marshall is more about subdual than “Leadership” specifically, but they share the Leadership/Coercion space)

Warden(The Warden is a defensive coercion character, which is pretty close. Obviously the Warden is more of a martial artist)

Sepratist Commander(Coercion as Leadership is their core overlap)

Warden(The teacher is more all-in on teaching and sharing skills and talents. The Instructor is more about being a Force-Multiplier in combat, but they share a similar core.)

Media Touchstones

ARC Trooper CT-7567 “Rex”(Clone Wars, Rebels)

CT-9901 “Hunter” (The Bad Batch)

Vel Sartha (Andor Season 2)

“Gunny” Highway (Heartbreak Ridge)

Gunnery Sergeant Hartman (Full Metal Jacket)

Sgt. Lipton/Sgt. “Bull” Randleman (Band of Brothers)

maintainer.name: Maintainer
maintainer.description:
At a Glance

The Maintainer is the full service motor pool and armory technician that can fly a sortie in a pinch.

All-in or Hybrid?

1/2 Generic Calibration & Repair

1/2 Ship Management

What Should it be the Best At?

Taking gear from broken to Better than new

Performing ship-saving heroics mid combat

What should it be just “good” at?

General Mechanics

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Mechanic - As its replacement, they are going to share a ton of connectivity, mannerly in their focus on vehicles. The maintainer will have a bit more of an improvement angle, and less focus on skulduggery.

Outlaw Tech - Their overlap is less about that their working about, and more that they are all spit and polish kitbashers.

Modder - The Modder shares the general split between personal gear and vehicle focus. Where they differ is that the Maintainer is less worried about perfection of gear and more about basic functionality and minor improvements in the moment

mastermind.name: Mastermind
mastermind.description: Please see page 28 of the Cyphers and Masks Sourcebook for details.

mechanic.description:
MECHANIC—Mr. Fix-it

At a Glance

The default technical generalist in the setting, the mechanic equal parts cobbler, ship doctor, and technical problem solver.

All-in or Hybrid?

½ Mechanics Problem Solver & Generalist, ½ Ship Doctoring

What Should it be the Best At?

Broad-Spectrum Mechanic-ing

Ship Damage Repair

What should it be just “good” at?

Crafting

Piloting

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Rigger

Modder

Artisan

Media Touchstones

Anakin Skywalker (circa Episode I: The Phantom Menace)

Chewbacca

Peli Motta (The Mandalorian)

Updated 12/10/2025

propagandist.description:
PROPAGANDIST—PITHY DESCRIPTION

At a Glance

The propagandist is the covert mass communication specialist. They are the master of disseminating information and putting truths and lies to their best respective truths. They function as a storyteller in a galaxy full of War Stories.

All-in or Hybrid?

⅓ Group-based Deception ⅓ Group Based Charm ⅓ Knowledge & Perception Utility 

What Should it be the Best At?

Twisting broad narratives to influence populations and groups.

Playing up the benefits of the Rebellion for people.

Appearing impartial as an agent of a military unit.

What should it be just “good” at?

Being charming

Being Deceptive

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Agitator(Have a similar vibe of being something of an agitator in the Imperial sense, but more focused on spreading a message than specifically working and enervating a Rebel cell)

Politico(The major overlap is their shared interest in controlling narratives and pulling strings, but the Politico does so for personal gain and on a much smaller scale, whereas the Propagandist tries to sway entire groups of people).
Agitator(Have a similar vibe of being something of an agitator in the Imperial sense, but more focused on spreading a message than specifically working and enervating a Rebel cell).

Media Touchstones

Nemik (Andor)

Diana Allers (Mass Effect 3)

Joo Dee (Avatar The Last Airbender)

updated 12/10/2025

quartermaster.description:
QUARTERMASTER—PITHY DESCRIPTION

At a Glance

The Quartermaster is the person in charge of armaments, requisitions, and general preparedness for any military operation. They are both the gateway to and gatekeeper for any tools of rebellion.

All-in or Hybrid?

½  General Negotiation & Making Credits ¼ Supplies and Material-Based Utility ¼ Narrative Forward Debuffing

What Should it be the Best At?

Procurement of material for the waging of war[BR
Managing resources in a military unit

What should it be just “good” at?

Negotiation not relating to supply

Computers, but not slicing.

Being detail-oriented

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Entrepreneur(second-closest match after the Trader. They share a shrewd logistics sense for making money do work, but the focus of the QM is to put the money to greatest effect, not having money make more money)

Analyst(Their overlap is specifically in their attention to detail and how that effects their allies. The QM has even less of a computers focus than the Analyst).

Trader(Probably the closest of the trees. It’s about the stuff, not the money. Especially with how the characters can dip into the underhandness).

Media Touchstones

RADAR (M*A*S*H)

Red (Shawshank Redemption)

Steve Cortez (Mass Effect)

updated 12/11/2025

rigger.description:
RIGGER—”I AM MY SHIP”

At a Glance

The Rigger is the ultimate “I am my ship” specialization, where the character’s progression directly correlates to their ship’s excellence. They are the master of just passively turning their ship both effective and unkillable.

All-in or Hybrid?

4/5 Signature Vehicle ⅕ Outfitting And Acquisition

What Should it be the Best At?

Shipboard Survivability

What should it be just “good” at?

Outfitting Their Vehicle (generally)

Mechanics

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Modder(A split “signature equipment” specialization that cares about weapons and vehicles in equal measure. The Rigger is 100% more interested in the ship, big or small.)

Shipwright(Does most of their excellence when building the Vehicle. So in that way they are similar in that they pregame a lot of their excellence, but the Education focus of the Shipwright gives it a tonne of mid-adventure utility.)

Media Touchstones

Lando Calrissian (Solo)

L3-37 (Solo)

Kenickie (Grease)

Michael Knight (Knight Rider)

Max Rockatansky (Mad Max)

saboteur.description:
SABOTEUR

At a Glance

The Saboteur is one part infiltration expert, one part demolitions expert, and one part technical saboteur. They sneak in, perform precise disabling, and get out, usually through a hole they made.

All-in or Hybrid?

⅓ Stealth and Infiltration ⅓ Direct Combat Explosives ⅓ Technical Dismantling 

What Should it be the Best At?

Covert Subterfuge

Explosives and Mechanics as applied to Subterfuge

What should it be just “good” at?

General Mechanics

Slicing/Infiltration

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Thief(Serious overlap with regard to covert break ins, but there isn't a focus on destruction, mostly slipping in and skipping out).

Infiltrator(Big focus on infiltration is shared, and military subterfuge, but leverage traditional combat as a tool rather than explosives).

Slicer(Overlap in espionage, but ultimately explosives are louder than most slicing eventualities).

Media Touchstones

Updated 12/10/2025

sapper.description:
SAPPER

At a Glance

Sapper is the battlefield engineer through and through. They are about fortifications building and destruction, with a heavy emphasis on explosions

All-in or Hybrid?

⅙ Fortification Building ⅙ Countermobility ⅓ Fortification Destruction/Sapping ⅓ General Explosives 

What Should it be the Best At?

Dealing with the ins and outs of base building and enemy fortification destruction 
Large Explosives, especially charges

Battlefield Impediments

What should it be just “good” at?

General Mechanics

Survival

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Saboteur(The Sapper is a hammer whereas the Saboteur is more like a well-placed dagger, as far as subterfuge is concerned).

Demolitionist(They share a focus on blowing stuff up, but the only thing that the Demo actually makes is bombs, whereas the Sapper focuses heavily on fortifications).

Media Touchstones

Updated 12/10/2025

scientist.description:
At a Glance

The scientist is the “creation-focused” Scholarly archetype that serves to role-fill as the “swiss army smartypants” that can do any number of important intelligence things in the party. Scientists know things and they make things.

All-in or Hybrid?

½ Using Knowledge for General and Social Utility ½ Using Int-Based Skills to Craft/Make Things/Improve Things

What Should it be the Best At?

Scientist ideally should be the best at making things, but not in a Grease-Monkey kind of way

Knowing Things, a-la the Scholar

What should it be just “good” at?

Medicine

Mechanics

Computers

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Scholar(The closest as a 1 to 1. The Scientist cares heavily about knowing things, but doesn’t go deep as the scholar. It tries to leverage pure intelligence though).

Doctor(They both share medicine and both leverage knowledge socially, but that’s about it. The Medicine side of the Scholar is very understated).

Analyst(Very similar trees. They have socially-leaning Knowledge side that centers around utility, and the other half leans towards  a different niche (computers). But while it’s a single niche for Analyst, it’s more like 3 niches for Scientist).

Media Touchstones

Mordin Solus (Mass Effect 2)

Praxideke Meng (The Expanse)

Miranda Lawson (Mass Effect)

updated 12/11/2025

scout.description:
SCOUT - BLAZING THE TRAIL

At a Glance

The scout is the perfect “roughing it" support specialization, acting as a Chiss Army Knife in those situations, assisting their allies in a number of way out in the wild.

All-in or Hybrid?

Hybrid, probably 3-way between active scouting and naturalism, and role-filling in the party.

What Should it be the Best At?

Surviving and Traversing the wilderness

Actually Scouting

Initiative Support

What should it be just “good” at?

Athleticism

Piloting Planetary

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Pathfinder

Navigator

Survivalist

Media Touchstones

Mad Max/Furiosa

Rey (circa Episode VII: The Force Awakens)

Updated 12/10/2025

shipwright.description:
At a Glance

The Shipwright is the craftiest crafter in the game, and on top of getting the most out of developing new ships, they also can eke the most out of their designs in structured encounter

All-in or Hybrid?

¼  Ship-Improvement In Encounters ¼  Crafting Focus ¼  Anti-Ship Gunnery ¼ Ship Repair

What Should it be the Best At?

Building and Situationally-Improving Starships

What should it be just “good” at?

Piloting Gunnery Knowing Stuff

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Droid Tech(Heavily invested in Crafting, but the goal is completely different. It invests in talents that leverage multi-step crafts the same way).

Rigger(TImproves ships passively rather than actively. Also doesn’t “make” ships).

[IMechanic(The Mechanic is more about protecting the ship, which isn’t the priority of the shipwright. But they both dedicate a few slots to repairing the ship).

Media Touchstones

Quarie (Star Wars: Rebels)

Frankie (One Piece)

slicer.description:
SLICER

At a Glance

Slicer is the quintessential hacker. They infiltrate the analogue computer systems of Star Wars the way a thief picks a lock, and if thy're lucky, get away unnoticed.

All-in or Hybrid?

⅔ Slicing & Computers, ⅙ General Stealth, and ⅙ Underworld Stuff

What Should it be the Best At?

Slicing & Computers

What should it be just “good” at?

Stealth

Underworld fixing

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Strategist(More of a military analyst than an aggressive slicer, but cyber-warfare is)

Analyst(The analyst plays more into the helpful support archetype, and the slicing is more of a sub niche))

Media Touchstones

D.J. (Episode XIII: The Last Jedi)

Conder Nash (Star Wars Aftermath: Life Debt)

Updated 12/10/2025

squadron_leader.description:
SQUADRON LEADER—”WAIT FOR MY SIGNAL”

At a Glance

The Squadron Leader is the tip of the spear, the first to call the attack, the retreat, evasive maneuvers, etc. 

They make the call when there's a shot to be made.

All-in or Hybrid?

½  Leadership ½ Squad-Based piloting

What Should it be the Best At?

Squad Based Piloting

What should it be just “good” at?

Armed Conflict

Piloting

Dogfighting

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Wingmate(Definitely a party-focused pilot, but a good bit different. The Wingmate covers for their allies, whereas the Leader managers the action economy)

Warden(The Warden is a defensive coercion character, which is pretty close. Obviously the Warden is more of a martial artist)

Instructor(The Ground-level version of the Wingmate, all about managing the action economy)

Merc Soldier(definitely the “warrior who leads", which is about where the Squadron lives)

Media Touchstones

Garvin Dreis “Red Leader” (ANH)

Wedge Antilles (ESB and ROTJ)

Antoc Merrick (Rogue One)

strategist.description:
STRATEGIST—ANALYZING THE DATA

At a Glance

The Strategist is both the intelligent battle-leading Master of War, and the gifted know it all who can come in clutch when knowing is half the battle. 

All-in or Hybrid?

½ Knowledge-Based War Leader ½ Warfare & General Knowledge Specialist

What Should it be the Best At?

Mass Combat

Putting Knowledge to Work

What should it be just “good” at?

Initiative as a niche

Force Multiplying

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Analyst(They both have a serious investment in knowledge, and while the Analyst is more generalist and supportive in non-combat scenarios)

Tactician(If the Strategist is the master of war, the tactician is the master of Battle. The tactician focuses more preparedness and cunning, where the Strategist is all on knowledge)

Figurehead(More of a head of state or military-oriented diplomat, the figurehead can lead the war through sheer force of personality. They support in non mass combat situation with Presence vs the Strategist’s intellect)

[IScholar(Shares the scholar’s utility in using knowledge for utility and as a force multiplier, but isn't as all in on it)

Media Touchstones

Grand Admiral Thrawn (Star Wars: Rebels)

Jan Dodonna (Andor, Rebels, ANH)

Crix Madine (ROTJ)

Sima Yi (Romance of the Three Kingdoms)

Ender (Ender’s Game)

tactician.description:
TACTICIAN—PITHY DESCRIPTION

At a Glance

The Tactician is the perfect melding of the squad-based NCO and the battle commander. They manage the tactics, battle plan, and sometimes lead the charge against the enemy. 

All-in or Hybrid?

⅕ Competent Ranged Combatant 2/5 Squad Commander 2/5 Ground Combat Tactical Leader

What Should it be the Best At?

Ground Combat Battle Planning

What should it be just “good” at?

Ranged Combat

Survivalism

Leadership

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Mercenary Soldier(the Merc Soldier is a gunman who can lead, whereas the Tactician is a Warleader who can shoot. They definitely have a ton of overlap)

Squadron Leader (SL and Tactician are definitely similar in that they are embedded in a unit to some extent. The Squadron Leader obviously belongs in space, but it has the half fighter, half leader vibe. The Tactician has a decided lean towards leadership)

Instructor(much like the SL, it's a half leader, half unit fighter. Obviously more of a defensive leader)

Commodore(Probably the closest to a space counterpart. Commodore is much better while in their signature command, but can still excel otherwise. They are much more of a utility + Leader)

Warleader(Probably the closest to a 1 for 1. It's all about leadership and survival and combat. The force element is not even as pronounced as it could have been)

Clone Commander(More of a Commodore + Strategist, but there are similarities in the percentage of leadership it does)

Media Touchstones

Micha Evron (Twilight Company)

Captain Rex (Star Wars: Clone Wars)
 
General Reikan (Empire Strikes Back)

wingmate.name: Wingmate
wingmate.description:
WINGMATE—Pilot Replacement

At a Glance

The Wingmate is the ultimate flying support tree. They keep their head on a swivel to make sure their allies are prepared for danger and ready for the next sortie.

All-in or Hybrid?

⅔  Piloting Generalist ⅓ Space Piloting Support

What Should it be the Best At?

Defending allies in space combat

What should it be just “good” at?

Piloting Space Generalist

Dogfighting

Initiative

Specs for Comparison / Inspiration

Pilot (RAW)(The Wingmate maintains many of its core elements, but doesn't go to the same extremes with all of them, specially top speed and damage output)

Vanguard(Generally the idea of a “initiative"-forward bodyguard, but less emphasis on personal tankiness.)

Bodyguard(Very similar, using vigilance instead of perception)

Media Touchstones

Wedge Antilles (A New Hope)

Coran Horn (Rogue Squadron Books)
